annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and threshold-form symmetric-dilation formalization

assumptions: The norm threshold L is nonnegative.
Matrices and vectors are finite and real, as in the paper.
The largest-eigenvalue statement is represented equivalently by scalar-identity quadratic-form order at every nonnegative threshold.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P06 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P06 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p06_t2_self_adjoint_dilation_norm_bridge {m n : Nat} (M : Fin m -> Fin n -> Real) (L : Real) (hL : 0 <= L) : p06RectOpNorm2Le M L iff p06FiniteLoewnerLe (p06SelfAdjointDilation M) (L * I)
formal_statement.plain_language: A rectangular matrix has operator norm at most L exactly when its symmetric dilation is at most L times the identity in quadratic-form order.

informal_proof: For the forward implication, write a dilation vector as (y,x), use Cauchy-Schwarz and 2ab <= a^2+b^2. For the reverse implication, test the quadratic-form bound on a scaled pair aligned with Mx and optimize the scale.
informal_statement: The all-threshold quadratic-form version of the symmetric-dilation norm identity in equation (3.4).
